verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Stripe CLI is documented at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli. However, the pack only establishes that it exists. Nothing shows what the CLI can do for Stripe Tax specifically, such as running tax calculations, managing registrations, or pulling reports, or how well it fits AI-agent workflows. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI covers Tax operations, detailed CLI docs in the pack, hands-on or independent confirmation of using the CLI with Tax.
